chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Sinan from a man from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Breaking the fast with water washes away the sins of the heart."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of breaking fast with water according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration linking the Sunnah practice of breaking fast with water to the spiritual purification of the heart, emphasizing simplicity in worship. This act is viewed not merely as physical sustenance but as a means of washing away minor sins, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interplay between physical rituals and inner spiritual states. The tradition underscores the prophetic precedent of following the Prophet's (peace be upon him) example in daily acts of devotion to achieve closeness to God.
